summary: Oriental Mindoro 1st District representative with 52 principal-authored bills. Authored an annually rising income tax exemption ceiling; co-authored the national minimum wage. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
